Hi Brian / Priya —

Thanks again for the time on the call yesterday. Per our discussion, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute POC kickoff to align scope, owners, and success criteria so the engineering and procurement teams are all on the same page before we start the trial.

Proposed agenda (60 min):
- Introductions + roles (5m)
- POC goals & success criteria (10m)
- Environment & network requirements (10m)
- Timeline, milestones, owners (15m)
- Procurement / SOW & next steps (10m)
- Q&A (10m)

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Mar 24, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 25, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Mar 26, 09:00–10:00

Owners from our side:
- AE / Program lead: Dev Patel (me)
- Solutions Engineer: Soojin Lee
- Customer Success: Vivek Kulkarni (on-call for milestone tracking)

Attached: draft POC success criteria and a preliminary SOW for procurement to review.

Can you confirm which window works best and whether any additional attendees (security / network ops) should be included? If procurement needs extra lead time we can push later — just let me know constraints.

Thanks,
Dev
